sections.text:
Professional Summary
Professional with years of experience as Senior Business Analyst in Banking, Finance, Insurance, and E-commerce domains. Proven expertise in requirement gathering, process improvement, regulatory compliance, and project management. Adept at bridging business and technology, managing end-to-end project lifecycles, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, UAT coordination, API integration, and documentation (BRD, FRD, SOPs). Known for delivering data-driven insights and improving operational efficiency through structured problem-solving and collaboration.

sections.label: Skills
sections.text:
Core Competencies
Requirements Gathering & Analysis ● Business Requirement document, Functional Requirement Document & Test cases scenario and execution. ● UAT Testing and coordination. ● Preparing Impact analysis document. ● Documenting Deployments note for Live Deployment. ● Project Planning & Delivery ● Regulatory Compliance (CKYC, RBI, NSDL, CDSL). ● Cross-functional Collaboration with Team Management and Interpersonal skills. ● Hands-on experience in JIRA, Load Runner, Service Now MS office. ● API Integrations and Implementations. ● Proficiency with Oracle SQL,, Postman Tools. ● Process walkthrough and creating SOPs and manuals for knowledge sharing. ● Stakeholders Management and Collaboration ● Gap Analysis documentation ● Drive project lifecycle from requirement inception to post-go-live support ● Workshops, Demos & End-User Training ● Production Support & Post-Go-Live Monitoring ● Support production validations, DR drills, and post-release issue triaging
Technical Skills
Tools: JIRA, Service Now,HP LoadRunner, UIPath, Postman, API, Arcos portal, ● Databases: MySQL, Oracle SQL ● Operating Systems: Windows, Linux
